receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for the refusal event.

scenario_id.description: Scenario identifier tied to the enterprise-shaped scenario packet.

gate_version.description: Version of the synthetic gate or gate primitive used for the refusal event.

policy_reference.description: Policy or scenario rule used to evaluate the attempted action.

execution_layer_event.description: Execution-layer trace event. In v0.1 this is synthetic/in-memory only.

attempted_action.description: The consequence-binding action that attempted to execute.

actor.description: The AI agent, system, or service requesting execution.

action_type.description: The governed action class being evaluated.

recipient_scope.description: The recipient or domain scope for the attempted action.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the payload that would have been sent or executed.

missing_field.description: The required field that caused refusal, if applicable.

decision.description: Gate verdict. Refusal receipts normally record DENY or HOLD.

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the action was refused.

timestamp.description: Time the gate produced the refusal event.

downstream_send.description: Whether the outbound send occurred after gate evaluation.

downstream_effect_claimed_status.description: Status of the downstream effect claim. v0.1 uses synthetic_no_effect_observed only.

evidence.description: Evidence items supporting the refusal claim.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit statement of what the receipt does and does not prove.
